why: Shell cycle 4 (docs/v3/cycles/shell-4.md, P1 shell-4.1): a deep link to a record leaves an empty sheet in the document, stuck half closed. On `/cycle/shell-4/services?service=checkout&deploy=checkout-093` at 1800, Tab past the aside's Close panel moves into a `sheet-content` parked at x 1800. The sheet slides over the docked aside, and Tab, Shift+Tab and Escape keep focus on its Close button: a keyboard trap (`.evidence/cycle-shell-4/inspect.log` I1, `shots/i1-tab-past-aside-1800.png`). At 390 the same empty sheet sits below the viewport and outlives the record's Close. Tab after More lands on its invisible Close (`inspect2.log` I7). The element carries `data-closed` and `data-ending-style` from its first appearance and is never seen open (I10). A record opened by a click leaves none (I2), nor does Back reopening one (I8). Cycle 3's route has it too (I6). Cause: the page's aside mounts after the table's first render, so a deep link shows the entry in the table's own sheet first. When the aside takes over, `setHost` hides that sheet (`src/table/use-data-table.ts:508-520`, `previous.hide()`). The own sheet (`src/table/parts/detail-sheet.tsx:54`) closes before its popup ever painted open, and its exit never finishes, so the popup stays mounted and focusable.
what: A deep-linked record shows in its page's aside only: no sheet of the table's own is left in the document, open or closing, at any width.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/table/use-data-table.ts (setHost and the deep-link show) and its tests
packages/basalt-ui/src/page/page.tsx (the detail host context, only if the fix needs the page's host known at first render)
packages/basalt-ui/docs/use-data-table.md, packages/basalt-ui/docs/page-aside.md (only where the behaviour is described)
change:
Two parts, either of which may carry the fix; the test holds both:
- The table's own sheet does not open while the enclosing `Page` will host the detail: a deep link waits for the page's aside, or the page's host is known on the table's first render (`detail-sheet.tsx`, `use-data-table.ts` `setHost`, `page.tsx`).
- A sheet that closes before it painted open unmounts at once instead of waiting on an exit that never runs (`detail-sheet.tsx`).
A table with no page host keeps its own sheet for a deep link, as now.
commits: fix: commits in packages/basalt-ui, granular (the deep-link host, the stuck sheet, the layout test).
proof: make check; a layout test that deep-links a record into a page with a `PageAside` at 1800 and at 390 and finds no `sheet-content` without `data-open`, then walks Tab past the aside's close (1800) or the record's close (390) to the document end.
acceptance: A deep-linked record at 1800 leaves no `sheet-content` in the document beside the docked aside (layout test)
At 1800, Tab past Close panel on a deep-linked record reaches the document end; no focus is kept in a sheet (layout test)
At 390, after the deep-linked record's sheet closes, no `sheet-content` remains (layout test)
A table with no page host still opens a deep-linked record in its own sheet (test)
